title: Yellow Croatian Myeongnan Roe Lasagna
description: A flexitarian-friendly Croatian dish featuring myeongnan-roe, with a citrusy glaze and cheese-pull, evoking nostalgic feelings. This lasagna is a unique twist on traditional Croatian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions.
In a bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, and myeongnan-roe.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and salt.
Spread a layer of the lemon juice mixture on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the lemon juice mixture.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture on top of the noodles.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the lemon juice mixture, and finally the remaining ricotta cheese mixture.
Top the lasagna with additional parmesan cheese.
Bake the lasagna for 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
